★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Hannah taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
a soft green glow under the water
